headline: JetBlue Shares Surge Over 11% on Strong Revenue Outlook Despite Q3 Miss
summary: JetBlue Airways shares rose more than 11% following a strong revenue outlook, despite missing third-quarter estimates.
why: JetBlue Airways Corporation is a major low-cost passenger airline based in the United States, traded under the ticker JBLU.

impacts.name: JetBlue Airways
impacts.why: Strong revenue outlook drove investor optimism, pushing the stock price higher.

why_moved: Better-than-expected revenue guidance provided reassurance to investors, overcoming a Q3 earnings miss and triggering a sharp rally in the stock.
